title: Stairway to Heaven
composer: Jimmy Page & Robert Plant / Led Zeppelin
description: The world's most famous acoustic intro and haunting verse melody, arranged for two hands (Grand Staff). Left hand walks the iconic chromatic bassline while the right hand arpeggiates the climbing chords.
generalTip: Key of A minor. Left hand plays the legendary descending bass (A -> G# -> G -> F# -> F -> G -> A), creating the spine-chilling harmony with the right hand.

sections.label: The Iconic Arpeggio
tips: 🪜 The legendary opening: Left hand descends (A -> G# -> G -> F#) while Right hand climbs (A -> B -> C -> D)!
🎹 Left hand: A, to G# (black key) then G, to F# (black key)
👆 Right hand: C-E rolls into high a, high b, high c', and high d'
